set-variable.name: tenantId

policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="tokensUsed" value="@{
            try {
                var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                return body["usage"]["total_tokens"].ToString();
            } catch {
                return "50";
            }
        }" />
        
            https://inriver-aigw-credits.happystone-8616c4eb.swedencentral.azurecontainerapps.io/api/consume
            POST
            
                application/json
            
            @("{\"tenantId\": \"" + (string)context.Variables["tenantId"] + "\", \"tokens\": " + (string)context.Variables["tokensUsed"] + "}")
        
        
            @((string)context.Variables["tenantId"])
        
        
            @((string)context.Variables["tokensUsed"])
        
        
            @{
                try {
                    var resp = ((IResponse)context.Variables["consumeResponse"]);
                    if (resp.StatusCode == 200) {
                        var body = resp.Body.As<string>();
                        var obj = Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(body);
                        return obj["remaining"].ToString();
                    }
                } catch {}
                return "unknown";
            }
